purpose: Shared coordination file for preparing research-only candidate trail packets for later normalized app import.

notes: The handoff files are research-only planning artifacts.
Do not wire runtime code or generated public data directly to these files.
If source evidence is missing or stale, mark it as unknown/recheck rather than inferring facts.

routeGeometry: Preserve official GPX/API segment breaks unless a trail-specific handoff explicitly authorizes a connector.
Record official displayed distance separately from computed geometry distance.
Represent non-walking transfers, ferry/boat legs, access spurs, alternate branches, and self-navigation gaps as explicit connector or access metadata rather than silently snapping linework.
Keep blocked or partial sections out of complete-route import until the app deliberately supports a partial/self-navigation model.
facilities: Normalize facilities by cluster first, then split into typed subfacilities only when source coordinates and app taxonomy support it.
Keep OSM-only, field-report-only, stale, private/customer-only, or source-contradictory amenities in pending/suppress states unless a trail-specific handoff says otherwise.
Treat commercial hours, seasonal services, transit schedules, boat operations, water reliability, cabin availability, and firewood availability as publication-time rechecks.
ruleWarnings: Separate hiker-facing safety/rule warnings from import-maintenance notes.
Scope protected-area, water-protection, fire, dog, camping, cycling, hunting, and closure rules to the route portions they actually affect when geometry supports it.
Recheck dynamic fire bans, storm/forestry damage, temporary route notices, and transport disruptions immediately before public display.
dedupe: Deduplicate overlapping routes and aliases before runtime import, especially Vikingaleden sections 7-12 against Upplandsleden.
Do not duplicate existing app facilities or route shards; create explicit aliases or alternateRouteRefs where appropriate.

executionPhases.name: Candidate normalized artifacts
executionPhases.output: Candidate-only normalized route/facility/rule artifacts under each trail folder

executionPhases.name: Runtime app integration
executionPhases.output: Normalized source data and generated runtime shards
